lines.t: **Verse 1**
Why would I run from Him?
Why would I leave His path?
Why would I choose this dark
When I know where freedom's at?
When every road I've chased
Has only led me farther away
I hear His voice calling
And I know the way
**Pre-Chorus**
I'm following Him, eyes straight ahead
His path is the one I tread
No turning back, no looking away
He's leading me every day
**Chorus**
Why would I walk away?
Why would I leave His name?
When He has called me out of darkness
And brought me into grace
Why would I turn around
When I know where I belong?
I've found the One I'm following
So why would I walk away?
**Verse 2**
There are a thousand voices
Trying to pull me aside
But I know the Shepherd's voice
And I know He'll be my guide
I don't need every answer
I don't need to know the road
If He is walking with me
I will follow where He goes
**Bridge**
I won't trade truth for a lie
I won't trade freedom for chains
I won't leave the One who found me
I won't go back again
My eyes are on Him, My eyes are on Him...
**Final Chorus**
Why would I walk away?
Why would I leave His name?
When He has called me out of darkness
And brought me into grace
Why would I turn around
When I know where I belong?
I've found the One I'm following
So why would I walk away?
